You've got a briefing in ten minutes, but I'd bet my pay that it's going to be at least a half-hour before the brass is ready.|Lieutenant Shara, to a team of Rebel agents|<ref name="OSG">{{FFG|story=Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta}}</ref>}}
'''Shara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who served as the [[Logistics officer/Legends|Logistics Officer]] of [[Titan Base]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].<ref name="OSG" />
